title: Chapter 605 - 605 Level-Eight Hellwater, Killed!
content:
Chapter 605 - 605 Level-Eight Hellwater, Killed!

Chapter 605 - 605 Level-Eight Hellwater, Killed!

605 Level-Eight Hellwater, Killed!

Lin Fan felt his body warming up.

Then, he began to understand.

As long as he willed it, he could gather energy and make his body thicker and bigger. It was very magical.

The corners of Lin Fan’s lips curled up slightly, and his footsteps became lighter.

In the distance, a gust of chilly wind suddenly blew over.

Sam could not help but shiver and say, “Why did it suddenly become cold?”

In the next moment…

Ceramic jars appeared in front of them.

The sight was eerie and strange.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing said, “Ceramic jars suddenly appeared.”

Qingchuan Calendar Hanyang Tree: [Ceramic jars? Are there humans in the Otherworld?]

Spring Won’t Come Back: [Are these ceramic jars antiques?]

123 Wooden Man: [God Lin is rich.]

Flower: [Does God Lin lack money?]

I Love the Sun: [The man-eating ceramic jars!]

Mary: [Yes! They’re man-eating ceramic jars! Not long ago, one had eaten Li Jinxuan from Corea!]

Waiting for You in the Wind: [God Lin, be careful.]

…

The Heavenly Hound sniffed and called out softly.

Lin Fan’s heart skipped a beat.

He could understand the words of the Heavenly Hound.

“There’s something in the jars.”

However, Lin Fan did not care too much about it.

There was something in the jars?

What could it be?

Could it be a monster?

Lin Fan was curious.

Perhaps, it was the Heavenly Hound’s bark that had disturbed the jars.

A jar nearby suddenly cracked.

In the next moment…

A stream of black sticky liquid flew toward the Heavenly Hound.

The Heavenly Hound was slightly shocked. It waved its sharp claws and instantly shattered the black sticky liquid.

Following that, several jars beside cracked.

Several strands of black sticky liquid flew toward the Heavenly Hound.

The Heavenly Hound either dodged quickly or attacked with its claws, constantly shattering the sticky liquid.

The number of cracked jars increased, and the volume and quantity of the black viscous liquid also increased.

Finally, the Heavenly Hound started to panic.

However, the Heavenly Hound was not to be trifled with. It roared toward the sky and spat out a huge fireball, dispersing and melting the black liquid.

Perhaps it was because the flames had burned the jars or the Heavenly Hound had completely enraged the black liquid…

All of the ceramic jars suddenly cracked, and endless black liquid spread out. It covered the sky and the sun. The place vaguely turned into a black ocean that filled the sky.

It was terrifying!

Then…

The rolling black liquid suddenly gathered and condensed.

It formed a giant monster that was about ten meters tall, with scarlet eyes and sharp fangs.

The monster roared, stirring up a gust of wind.

The wind blew the trees and leaves. It was extremely terrifying.

Even the Heavenly Hound could not help but feel its fur stand on end when it faced this monster, and its expression turned grim.

Sam’s legs gave way, and he fell to the ground.

This was the natural reaction of the weak when they saw the strong.

Lin Fan’s face was filled with curiosity.

“A monster transformed from the black liquid?

“It seems quite interesting.

“Right, it seems to be afraid of fire.”

As the sound of Lin Fan’s voice faded, a sea of fire rose up around him.

The sea of fire quickly condensed into a ten-meter-long flaming sword.

Lin Fan spat out one word, “Slash!”

[Skill: Sword 3!]

The flames and sword light intertwined.

The entire space seemed to have been sucked into a vacuum in an instant. It was silent.

In the distance, a gust of wind suddenly blew.

The surface of the huge monster was like a piece of ceramic that had been baked for too long, and fiery red cracks appeared on its surface.

In the next moment, the monster shattered into countless tiny black hard objects that fell to the ground with a dull sound.

The trees within a radius of hundreds of meters shattered like bubbles, turning into dust that filled the sky.

Then, an emotionless voice rang out in Lin Fan’s ears.

[First to kill level-eight Hellwater. You’ve obtained a level-eight treasure chest.]

[First to kill level-eight Hellwater. Hua Nation’s oil has increased by 50%.]

Lin Fan did not wait any longer and opened the treasure chest in front of him.

[500 Constitution points. Do you want to use them?]

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—5,000 Constitution points.]

The surging power was like a tidal wave that surged within Lin Fan’s body, causing his muscles and bones to start squirming.

Lin Fan looked at Sam, who was lying on the ground, and said, “Go and use your 500 Constitution points.”

They had spent the past few days together.

Even though Lin Fan had never thought of taking Sam as his disciple, he had a good impression of him.

Every time a stronger monster appeared, Sam would instinctively be frightened. It was not a good sight.

Therefore, it was necessary to give him 500 Constitution points.

Sam was still in a daze.

As a result, he did not even hear Lin Fan.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan waved his hand, and the light ball entered Sam’s body.

In an instant, Sam’s muscles grew rapidly, and the surging energy pulled him back to reality.

Sam looked at his hands in disbelief. “This… This…”

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

“Professor Lin is amazing!” Xiao Bing said excitedly.

Feng Clan: [I knew that God Lin was the strongest!]

God: [Awesome!]

Hongda: [The black liquid in those porcelain jars can actually fuse! Level-eight Hellwater. It’s a bit like poison.]

Cold Air Comes: [I told you, God Lin is a one-hit Superman!] He killed level-eight Hellwater with a single strike. Moreover, he used a flaming sword. It was so cool!]

Pfft: [Hua Nation’s oil production has increased by 50%! Now, we don’t have to worry about energy anymore. Thank you, God Lin.]

Bai Yang: [Thank you, God Lin.]

Messy: [Thank you, God Lin.]

…

In reality, it was not just the Hua people who were thanking Lin Fan.

Some people in Bai Country were also thanking Lin Fan.

When Gilbevan’s family saw Sam encounter the ceramic jars, especially when they saw the endless black liquid coming out of the jars, they were so scared that their faces turned pale.

When they saw Lin Fan kill the level-eight Hellwater and give the 500 Constitution points to Sam, the entire family jumped up in joy.

“Sam has obtained 500 Constitution points!”

“Sam has become even stronger than Superman!”

“Thank you, Master!”

“Thank you, Master!”

“Master isn’t at home. We have to thank Grandpa, Grandma, and Aunt!”

“That’s right!”

Thus, Gilbevan’s family rushed to Lin Fan’s house and called Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, Lin Xiaoyao, “Grandpa,” “Grandma,” and “Aunt” respectively non-stop.

Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, and Lin Xiaoyao opened their mouths, wanting to stop them.

In the end, they could only sigh.
